text_encoding: u16be byte length followed by exact UTF-8 bytes
digest_encoding: raw 32 bytes decoded from canonical lowercase SHA-256 hex
previous_checkpoint_encoding: presence byte 0 plus 32 zero bytes for null; presence byte 1 plus raw digest for non-null
integer_encoding: u64be except witness_slot encoded as one byte

candidate_mapping.dual_dsse_offline_witnesses: each closed witness statement binds its slot-specific challenge and exact checkpoint digest; DSSE signs exact statement bytes
candidate_mapping.dual_webauthn_human_witnesses: each WebAuthn clientDataJSON challenge is the raw 32-byte slot-specific challenge encoded by the WebAuthn client
